positions.name: ErasureAuthorityDirectives
positions.frame: What is authority doing when it orders the organization to forget a decision or purge knowledge of a project, rather than revisit or debate it?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare imperatives from the same speaker in the same submission, issued without justification, hedge, or appeal to process — 'Forget the Quantum Widget Decision' and 'Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration' both enact authority through the act of commanding erasure itself. They share the same flat register, present-tense irrealis directive shape, and settled/unhedged conviction; the only tension is scope (one names a discrete decision, the other names an entire body of institutional knowledge), but both read as the same unilateral erasure move performed twice in immediate succession.
